posts.title: CLIP closes 91.9% of its 311 tickets on time, best of the big agencies
posts.description: Philadelphia's Community Life Improvement Program closes 91.9% of 311 tickets within the published SLA — the highest rate among the city's big 311 agencies.

posts.title: Sheriff’s Office used to take ~20 days to record a deed. Now it’s 5x worse at 103.
posts.description: The Philadelphia Sheriff now takes about 103 days to record a deed, up from ~20 in 2015 and nearly 3x worse than a 2003 court order that requires them to be done within 40 days.

posts.title: Closing the Gap: $214M on the Table
posts.description: Philadelphia has $214M in uncollected real estate taxes across 55,557 parcels - up 9% in one year. Half the debt is owed by 10% of owners.
